info.title: Sentinel AI API — Razorpay Fraud Guardian
info.description:
**Sentinel AI** is a production-grade, defense-only payment-fraud detection and
explainability platform for Razorpay-scale payments.

It turns each payment into a decision through a three-model ensemble plus an
investigator, and never auto-approves a suspicious payment — it escalates to a
human review queue and a phone/OTP verification instead.

### Pipeline
`payment event -> feature engineering -> ML Risk + Behaviour AI + Graph Engine`
`-> Investigator ensemble -> decision (approve | review | block) + evidence`

### Persistence & infrastructure
* **Storage** — SQLAlchemy. SQLite for local/demo, **PostgreSQL** in production
  (`DATABASE_URL`): users, queries, feedback, transactions, verifications,
  review queue.
* **Cache** — OTP/verification sessions live in **Redis** (`REDIS_URL`) with a
  TTL so secrets expire on their own; falls back to an in-memory store locally.
* **Human review queue** — review-band payments are enqueued with explainable
  risk indicators and resolved by an analyst (feeds continual learning).
* **Phone verification** — OTP over call / SMS / WhatsApp (Twilio optional);
  simulated fully offline otherwise.

### Auth
Bearer token from `POST /api/auth/login`. Admin-only routes are marked
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`; a single **admin** role exists.

SENbot read-only search across the user database (by phone, user id,
name, card). Available to every authenticated role — but read-only: no
delete / integrity here. Admin uses the same endpoint for lookups.

delete.summary: Admin integrity action: delete a payer + their data.
delete.description:
ADMIN-ONLY integrity action: permanently remove a payer and ALL of their
stored data from the dataset + user database.

get.summary: One verification session with call script + state.

post.summary: Confirm with the caller's OTP (correct -> approve, wrong x3 -> block).
post.description:
Complete the phone call. Correct OTP -> APPROVE. Wrong OTP / cap exceeded
-> escalate to BLOCK. The payer's ownership confirmation is implicit via the
call script.

post.summary: Caller denied ownership -> escalate to block.
post.description: The payer denied making this payment -> escalate to BLOCK.
Regenerate the OTP and re-place the call.

post.summary: Score an event and return a phone-verification handle when it lands in the review band.
post.description:
Score an event and, if it lands on the medium-risk band, return a live
phone-verification handle ready for OTP confirmation.

get.description:
Human review queue: review-band payments with explainable risk indicators.
ADMIN ONLY.

post.summary: Resolve a queued review item (approve | block); feeds continual learning.
post.description:
Resolve a queued review-band payment (approve | block). The human verdict
is fed back into the continual-learning loop. ADMIN ONLY.

get.summary: List the static runbook entries SENbot indexes (admin).

post.summary: Ask SENbot a grounded question over the runbook + live data (admin).
post.description:
SENbot Q&A. Answers read-only over the runbook + live dataset, and always
carries can_manage=true for the admin.

get.description: Continual-learning status plus the labelled (and unlabelled) transaction log.

post.summary: Attach a confirmed label / manual correction to a scored event (admin).
post.description:
Manually correct the decision for a previously scored transaction.
Feeds the online corrector immediately and queues it for the next retrain.

post.summary: Retrain the supervised models on the base data + confirmed feedback (admin).
post.description:
Retrain the supervised models (ML Risk + Investigator) on the original
synthetic data PLUS all confirmed feedback, then hot-swap the live model.
Create a real Razorpay TEST order (requires rzp_test_ keys).

post.summary: Ingest a Razorpay payment.captured / order.paid webhook and score it.
post.description:
Ingest a real Razorpay 'payment.captured' (or 'order.paid') webhook and
run it through the fraud pipeline, returning live decision + evidence.
